items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and a bullock for the sin offering, and two rams, and a basket of unleavened bread
items.claim: Moses was instructed to take Aaron, his sons, garments, anointing oil, a bullock, two rams, and unleavened bread
items.object: Aaron and his sons, garments, anointing oil, bullock, rams, basket of unleavened bread

items.quote: And gather thou all the congregation together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation
items.claim: Moses was instructed to gather all the congregation at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation
items.place: door of the tabernacle of the congregation
